class.name: VignetteEffect
class.brief_description: The picture darkening towards its corners.
class.description: The picture darkens towards its corners, as through a real lens, drawing the eye to the middle. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, in each view (both eyes in VR), with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing.

members.member: How gradually the picture darkens: [code]0[/code] is a hard edge, [code]1[/code] starts from the center.
How dark the corners get, from [code]0[/code] (not at all) to [code]1[/code] (fully [member color]).
